info.title: Factory Control Plane API
info.description: REST surface: web <-> control plane. Domain terms follow CONTEXT.md; the full contract is in .scratch/distributed-software-factory/spec.md.

get.summary: Readiness probe. Confirms Postgres is reachable.

post.summary: Writes one row to Postgres using a client-generated id.

get.summary: Reads one row back from Postgres.
Redirects to GitHub's OAuth authorize screen.
Exchanges a GitHub OAuth code for a session. Sets the session cookie.

schema.description: One-time authorization code GitHub redirected back with.

parameters.description: One-time authorization code GitHub redirected back with.
parameters.name: code

post.summary: Local password login for the break-glass account, on its own route — never GitHub.
Revokes the current session.

get.summary: Projects the caller is a member of. Never a list of every Project (spec: "tidak bisa melihat apa pun di luar itu").

post.summary: Creates a Project. Org `owner` only.

get.summary: One Project. 403 (not a member) beats 404 for an id that does exist; 404 only for an id that genuinely doesn't.

403.description: Not a member. Body names the Project and the reason; an org owner's body also names the self-add escape hatch.

post.summary: Adds (or changes the role of) a Project member. Project `admin` only.
The org owner escape hatch this issue's acceptance criteria name: an owner denied a Project adds themselves as admin. Always audited.
Creates a Group. Any Project member.
Adds a Group member. Domain-layer invariant, not UI: the target must already be a member of the Group's Project.

400.description: Target is not a member of the Group's Project.

post.summary: Triggers a Pipeline over a ref. Reads the definition (and every prompt file it references) from that ref, validates, and — if valid — materializes the Run and its initial Graph in one transaction. Project `member`.

id.description: Client-generated Run id; a repeat of the same id is rejected by the primary key.

201.description: Created. `stepRuns` holds the Steps materialized up front — see the Run's `definition` for the rest of the Graph's shape.

400.description: Rejected before any row was written: an unknown ref, a missing definition or prompt file, a definition that fails validation, the combined size over the inline-storage limit, an unknown Step repo:, or a repeated Run id.

get.summary: Runs for a Project, newest first. Keyset pagination on id — no total count. `inFlight=true` filters ended_at IS NULL; `outcome=` filters a final verdict; the two are never combined.
One Run: its own copy of the definition and prompt files, plus its Graph so far.

post.summary: Exchanges a single-use join token for a runner id + bearer secret. The Runner writes both to a file on disk — never a hostname or IP carries identity (spec).

401.description: Token invalid, unknown, or already used.

post.summary: Long-polls for up to a server-randomized 20-30s (spec). 200 with `step_run: null` when the hold elapses with nothing to claim — that is not an error. 426 outside the supported protocol range; 503 + Retry-After above the hanging-connection cap.

The only command channel. Always 200, even outside the supported protocol range (spec) — a healthy-but-permanently-idle Runner still needs somewhere to be seen by an operator. `unknown_leases` and `cancel` are always disjoint lists with different meanings.
Full capabilities report, sent when the Runner's locally-computed caps_hash no longer matches what the last heartbeat reply confirmed (`caps_stale`).
CLI-local write of desired_state='draining' — the Runner asking to stop taking new work while finishing what it holds. See /runners/{id}/drain for the operator/UI path into the same column.
Mints presigned PUT grants for this turn's artifacts/session — replaces the previous grant list rather than adding to it (spec).
Records log chunk metadata, batch. Dedup at the primary key (step_run_id, attempt, seq), not in application code.
The commit point of a turn that ends by asking a human. Moves the StepRun to awaiting-human without a lease.

The commit point of a turn that ends succeeded/failed. Idempotent on lease_token itself: the same token replays the recorded outcome at 200; a stale one (superseded by a sweep, or the row was cancelled) is 409 and the Runner is fenced.

409.description: Lease no longer valid — cancelled, or superseded by another claim.

post.summary: Mints a single-use Runner join token. Org owner only. The raw token is returned exactly once — only its hash is ever stored.
Sets operator-written policy: slots and tags (spec: "kebijakan ditulis operator"). Org owner only.
Operator/UI write of desired_state='draining' — the same column the Runner's own /runners/me/drain writes (spec: "ditulis CLI lokal maupun tombol UI"). Org owner only.
Instant fencing, not killing (spec, verbatim): the Runner's secret stops authenticating from this point on, regardless of whether its process is still alive. Org owner only.
Authoritative cancel: the row goes `cancelled` immediately (spec: "Cancel otoritatif di control plane"). A /result already in flight for this StepRun is answered 409. Project member.

400.description: Already ended with a different outcome.

get.summary: Live-tail and archive in one endpoint. Long-polls up to 30s from `offset` and returns any chunks with seq >= offset as a list of 5-minute presigned GETs (never bytes). Archive is the same call with offset=0. Returns immediately, empty, once the StepRun has ended. Project member.

200.description: Ok. `ended: true` means nothing more can arrive — stop polling. One tab = one hanging connection; no SSE, no WebSocket.
